title: Proper lantern models from the dark lantern
desc: J asked for "proper lantern models" from the jar's dark lantern: smooth glass instead of stacked slabs, a richer gold frame, and new silhouettes. Row A refines the jar's pinched column, row B tries new shapes. Each turns once while the charge fills.

takes.name: Pinched column
takes.facts: the jar's rounded-triangle pinch made smooth, 3 degree helix; bevelled collars, double middle band, three corner ribs, triangle bail, port on top

takes.name: Hex pinch
takes.facts: six-facet glass with the 3 degree helix; faceted collars, a crown of six points, ring handle

takes.name: Gold cage
takes.facts: round pinched glass held by six curved gold ribs that bow out from it; domed cap, arched handle

takes.name: Tower
takes.facts: two stacked octagonal glass chambers with corner posts on a square plinth, spire crown with the port

takes.name: Orb
takes.facts: squat glass sphere in a gold gimbal (equator band and an upright hoop) on a short pedestal, small bail

takes.name: Hourglass prism
takes.facts: two triangular glass cones meeting at a gold waist ring, 3 degree helix, three legs, triangle bail
